bibl.title: Papyrology in its Second Century, and the Chester Beatty.
bibl.seg: Brian McGing, Papyrology in its Second Century, and the Chester Beatty.

Garrick Vernon Allen, Kelsie Gayle Rodenbiker, Anthony Philip Royle, Jill Unkel & Usama Ali Mohamed Gad (edd.), The Chester Beatty Biblical Papyri at Ninety. Literature, Papyrology, Ethics = Manuscripta Biblica. 10 (Berlin - New York, 2023) pp. 7-17, figg.
bibl.note: Discusses the history, contributions, and some limitations of papyrology as a field of study, as well as a few unpublished documentary papyri from Narmouthis now in the Chester Beatty.
